name: manual_d232d1
claim: A plan/audit document's own 'Done' status table is not proof the work is actually done for every row -- verify each claimed-complete item against the real filesystem/content individually, the same rigor as verifying an external upstream claim, just scoped internally to this repo's own docs.

decisions.notes: orama's 2026-08-03-hermes-openclaw-graft-audit-plan.md Wave 0 table marked 8 items 'Done' (taxonomy doc, REGISTRY.yml dispatch_lane field, SKILL.md lane tags, a $OPENCLAW_ROOT scrub across references/results/*.md, etc). Checked all 8 individually against the actual filesystem/grep content rather than trusting the table: 7 were genuinely true, but the $OPENCLAW_ROOT scrub claim was false for one specific file (fleet-2026-07-27-rtx3080-hermes-brain-merge.md still had two literal path references). A 7/8 pass rate on an internal 'Done' table is exactly the kind of partial-truth a status table can hide -- each row needs independent verification, not a spot check of a couple.
